Use the attached reference as the only character model and create a professional 3D-rendered running animation turn sequence, on a transparent SQUARE atlas of 2 columns × 2 rows, exactly four large FULL BODY images. Original character costume, materials and face locked. All poses seen from same three-quarter angle, with motion toward the RIGHT of the frame; do not mirror the whole character. Keep same facial angle and eyes pointed screen-right. Careful production motion study: RIGHT LEG AND LEFT LEG MUST ALTERNATE. Both feet and near/far hands remain visible in every frame. Frame A and C must be dramatically different original drawings. The foreground near leg has a golden boot spur to identify it in ALL positions. The back (far) boot has no spur and is darker. 
Upper LEFT A = near boot with golden spur extended into foreground, toe at screen right, far boot trails at left; opposite far hand forward, near hand back, facing right. 
Upper RIGHT B = contact after near boot lands: front near knee pads body weight with bent knee, far thigh swings forward and far boot is off the floor. 
Lower LEFT C = FAR LEG fully leading the stride, pointing to the right and seen foreshortened (darker, mostly behind body), the big NEAR boot with the gold spur is almost horizontal as it pushes BACK towards screen LEFT. Near knee and toe are far apart and the near arm now punches forward to the right, far arm sweeps back. Dramatically different body silhouette than A. Very clear THIS near leg trails behind the hero extending TO THE LEFT; foreground golden-spurred boot at the LEFT EDGE of the silhouette. Emphasize strong running animation, knees really move independently, torso countertwists, NO repeated pose. 
Lower RIGHT D = right near knee lifted prominently UP AND FORWARD in front of torso, near boot suspended clear of floor, farther back foot in ground contact. 
Think animation supervisor checking all four keys actually alternate and join. Briefly airborne in each extreme. Ensure each pose leaves generous 12% transparent space around it and cannot touch adjacent. No labels, no shadows, no backgrounds, no grid lines, no VFX. 2x2 only. Strong polished cartoon 3D arena mobile game art directed like the reference, generous head, chunky anatomy, sharp materials.
